technique_why: A soft, simple indoor scene of big shapes (wall, window, sill, blanket, cat) that paints naturally back to front on white canvas, with the cat built from an oval and a circle the way a beginner tutorial does it.
subject: A gray tabby cat curled asleep on a yellow knit blanket on a wooden windowsill, a blue wall behind and leaves through the window
focal_point: The cat's sleeping face: the closed eyes, the pink nose, the whiskers and the white paws tucked under the chin
light: Daylight from the window at the upper left, lighting the left of the cat's head, the top of the blanket and a patch of the sill
why: Start with the far things a beginner can't spoil: the view through the window and the blue wall, then the window frame and the sill in front of them. The blanket goes on next as the cat's bed, and the cat is built last as a gray shape, shaded, given its white patches and stripes, and furred, so the most steps go to the sleeping face at the very end.

things.name: The sky through the window
things.called: the pale blue sky seen through the window
things.why: A pale, soft gradient behind the leaves, blended wet in one go.

things.name: The leaves outside the window
things.why: A loose mass of green leaves, dabbed dark then light.
things.plain: loose dark green leaf dabs against the pale sky

things.name: The blue wall
things.why: A plain background that goes from deeper blue by the window to a softer blue, blended wet; sky-blend is the closest element for a smooth wall.

things.name: The white window frame
things.why: Straight cream-white bars built from rectangles, then a lavender shadow side.
things.plain: the flat cream-white window frame and its crossbar

things.name: The wooden windowsill
things.why: A long warm-brown slab built from a rectangle top and a front edge, then shaded and given its sunny patch.

things.name: The yellow knit blanket
things.why: A folded roll of knit built from pieces; its knit loops are short press-and-lift marks, dark then light. shaped-object has no knit step of its own, so the shading and light passes carry the loops.

things.name: The sleeping tabby cat
things.why: A short-haired cat with stripes and white patches: exactly what this element builds, face last.
things.plain: the plain gray curled cat shape
things.left_out: The fine tabby lines inside the stripes, the eyelashes and the separate toes are left out; the stripes are single tapered marks and the paws are plain white mounds.

steps.name: Blend the sky in the window

lays.what: the whole window opening at the left edge, a pale sky blue, a little lighter low down, run straight through where the frame will go

steps.after: The left quarter of the canvas, from the top down to the sill line, is a smooth pale blue sky. The rest of the canvas is bare white.
steps.why: The farthest thing in the picture goes on first.

steps.name: Dab the dark leaves

lays.what: loose clumps of leaf green over most of the window opening, with sky showing between them

steps.after: Loose dark green leaf clumps fill the window opening, pale sky showing between them. No bright leaves yet; the rest of the canvas is bare.

steps.name: Dab the sunlit leaves

lays.what: smaller taps of bright yellow-green on the tops of the leaf clumps, leaving the dark green showing

steps.after: The leaves outside are finished: dark green clumps with bright yellow-green tops against pale sky. The rest of the canvas is bare.

stages.name: The wall and the window frame

steps.name: Blend the blue wall

lays.what: the whole canvas right of the window, top to bottom, deep blue next to the window fading to a softer blue across to the right edge, run straight through where the sill, blanket and cat will go

steps.after: Everything right of the window is a smooth blue wall, deeper blue by the window, softer to the right. The window view is untouched; no frame, sill, blanket or cat yet.

steps.name: Block in the window frame

lays.what: the window frame as flat cream-white rectangles: a wide upright post between the window and the wall, a thinner inner post, a crossbar across the view and the bottom ledge of the window

steps.after: A flat cream-white window frame (posts, crossbar and bottom ledge) stands over the window view and the wall's left edge, with no shading. Sill, blanket and cat are not there yet.

steps.name: Shade the frame's inner sides

lays.what: lavender gray bands down the inner sides of the posts, under the crossbar and along the bottom ledge

steps.after: The window frame is finished: cream white with lavender shadow bands on its inner sides. Sill, blanket and cat are not there yet.

steps.name: Block in the windowsill

lays.what: the whole sill as one flat warm-brown shape: a long slanted rectangle for its top across the bottom of the canvas, then a strip for its front edge

steps.after: A flat warm-brown sill runs across the bottom of the canvas under the window and the wall, with no shading or sunny patch. No blanket or cat yet.

steps.name: Shade the sill's front edge

lays.what: dark red-brown dry-brushed along the grain on the front edge, and a dark patch where the blanket will sit

steps.after: The sill has a darker front edge and a dark patch across its middle, warm brown on top. No sunny patch, blanket or cat yet.

steps.name: Lay the sunny patch on the sill

lays.what: a slanted patch of sunny peach on the sill's top at the left, below the window, broken by two brown bands where the frame's shadow falls

steps.after: The sill is finished: warm brown with a dark front edge and a peach patch of sunlight at the left, crossed by the frame's shadow. No blanket or cat yet.

steps.name: Block in the blanket

lays.what: the whole blanket as one flat golden-yellow shape: a long low oval for the rolled bed, then a curved roll along its front and the folded front edge, running in under where the cat will lie

steps.after: A flat golden-yellow blanket lies on the sill across the lower middle of the canvas, with no knit loops or shadows. The cat is not there yet.

steps.name: Tap in the dark knit loops

lays.what: rows of dark ochre comma loops in the knit, thickest under the roll, along the fold and on the lower front

steps.after: The golden blanket shows rows of dark ochre knit loops, densest under the roll and along the fold, with the gold showing between them. No light loops yet; no cat.

steps.name: Tap in the light knit loops

lays.what: fewer pale yellow comma loops on the tops of the roll and the fold, on the side facing the window

steps.after: The blanket is finished: golden knit with dark ochre loops in its folds and pale yellow loops on the lit tops. The cat is not there yet; the blue wall shows where it will lie.

steps.name: Block in the curled cat

lays.what: the whole cat as one flat mid-gray shape: a big oval for the curled body, a circle for the head at its left, two triangles for the ears, and curved pieces for the tail and the front paws, strokes following the fur

steps.after: A flat mid-gray curled cat shape lies on the blanket, with no shading, white patches, stripes, ears' pink or face.

steps.name: Shade the cat's shadow side
steps.unit: The cat's shading and white patches

lays.what: dark gray curved along the underside of the body, the curl of the tail, behind the head and in the deep fold where the head meets the body

steps.after: The gray cat has a dark underside, tail and fold behind its head, mid gray still on top. No white patches, stripes or face yet.

steps.name: Paint the white patches

lays.what: warm white on the muzzle and chin, the patch on the chest and side, and the two front paws, in 2 to 3 thin coats

steps.after: The gray cat now has a white muzzle, a white patch on its side and two white front paws. No stripes, pink ears or face yet.

steps.name: Pull the dark tabby stripes
steps.unit: The cat's stripes and pink ears

lays.what: charcoal stripes that taper and curve around the body, the tail, the top of the head and the cheeks

steps.after: The cat has curving charcoal tabby stripes over its gray body, tail and head. The ears are gray inside; no fur flicks or face yet.

steps.name: Paint the pink inside the ears

lays.what: soft pink inside both ear triangles, leaving a gray rim

steps.after: Both ears are pink inside with a gray rim. The fur is still smooth and there is no face yet.

steps.name: Flick in the light fur

lays.what: short light gray flicks over the top of the body and the head, more on the side facing the window, breaking the edges of the stripes

steps.after: The cat's coat looks furry: light gray flicks over its back and head, the darker gray and stripes showing between. The face is still blank: no eyes, nose or whiskers.

steps.name: Paint the pink nose

lays.what: a small pink triangle nose on the white muzzle

steps.after: The cat has a small pink nose. No closed eyes, mouth or whiskers yet.

steps.name: Line the closed eyes and mouth

lays.what: two curved charcoal lines for the closed eyes, a short line under the nose for the mouth, and a thin dark edge on the ears

steps.after: The cat's eyes are two curved closed lines and it has a small mouth under the pink nose. No whiskers yet.

steps.name: Pull the whiskers

lays.what: a few long thin warm-white whiskers fanning out from each side of the muzzle, over the cheeks and the blanket

steps.after: The finished painting: the gray tabby asleep on its yellow knit blanket, with long white whiskers out from its muzzle.
